description: This bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of instilled preferences for the GPT-4o-mini model, comparing three conditions: Control (gray), Before Introspection Training (light blue), and After Introspection Training (dark purple). The vertical axis, labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)", ranges from 0.00 to 1.00 in linear increments of 0.25, with tick marks at 0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, and 1.00. The horizontal axis is labeled "GPT-4o-mini" and contains a single category. For this single category, the Control bar (gray) reaches approximately 0.15 on the y-axis. The "Before Introspection Training" bar (light blue) is significantly taller, reaching approximately 0.55. The "After Introspection Training" bar (dark purple) is the tallest, reaching approximately 0.75. Each bar is accompanied by a vertical error bar indicating variability, with the error bars for the "Before" and "After" conditions being notably longer than for the "Control" condition. The bars are grouped side-by-side for the single model, and there is no indication of sorting or emphasis on any particular bar.
